show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/UXXMWQ
show.description: A simple elderly couple visits their billionaire son’s luxury empire to celebrate their anniversary, but their modest appearance makes the staff mistake them for beggars. Humiliated, tortured, and thrown out of their own empire, they silently endure brutal cruelty while their powerful son remains unaware of the truth. Royal Strangers is an emotional revenge drama about class, arrogance, hidden identity, and a family pushed to the edge.
